what_it_contains: SUPREME_EXECUTION_CONTRACT_V1.json -- 10 mandatory gates, 13 required receipt fields, status MANDATORY_FAIL_CLOSED_INTEGRATION_GLUE
INTERNALIZATION_MANIFEST.json -- 7/7 source blobs integrity-matched to upstream commit c062bec
what_i_found_by_looking_before_building.what_that_means: 775 lines of engineering discipline, a fail-closed contract, and a verified upstream import, executed by no code in the repository. The framework's own SKILL.md says it 'is guidance, not a runtime enforcement mechanism'. That sentence was true, and being true is what made it the largest unclaimed asset here.

why_this_was_the_right_place_to_spend__t.same_model_different_harness: 6.7% -> 68.3% on coding benchmarks from changing only the edit-tool format (Grok Code Fast); 52.8% -> 66.5% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 changing nothing but the scaffold (LangChain coding agent)
why_this_was_the_right_place_to_spend__t.token_tax: up to 40x token difference between harnesses on an identical model (KDD 2026 scaffold-effect study); Terminal-Bench 2.0 paper reports Opus 4.5 at 52.1% vs 57.8% across harnesses with a 65x token difference
why_this_was_the_right_place_to_spend__t.the_inference_that_matters_here: if scaffolding beats the model when the model HAS weights, it is everything when the model has none, because there is nowhere else for the capability to live
why_this_was_the_right_place_to_spend__t.and_for_speed: every gate below costs 98 microseconds, so 'insanely fast' and 'enforced' are not in tension

supreme_gate_engine_v1.what: the 10 declared gates and 13 required fields, executable; fail-closed; two terminal verdicts only
supreme_gate_engine_v1.coverage: 10 of 10 declared gates implemented, proven by contract_coverage() against the contract file itself
supreme_gate_engine_v1.self_check: 19 distinct negative cases -- every gate removed in turn, a boolean posing as test evidence, a prose test claim, a known acceptance gap, a read solution, an unrecognised contamination state, an unrecognised risk class, and a caller asserting its own authorization past a failed gate

failure_triage_v1.what: maps the 150+ FAIL_CLOSED__*/FAIL__* statuses this tree emits onto 8 causes and 7 recovery actions
failure_triage_v1.the_design_law_enforced_by_the_self_chec: two causes that share an action are one cause wearing two names -- the self-check found exactly that violation in my own first draft (CONTAMINATION and EXECUTION_FAILED both said FIX_THEN_RETRY) and it was split
failure_triage_v1.the_rule_that_matters: a PROVEN_LIMIT is never retryable, and an UNKNOWN failure STOPS rather than loops -- an unrecognised status is a hole in the table, not an invitation to retry

what_i_built_and_measured.wired_into_the_model: brain_one_model_v3.inventory() now reports engineering_contract_enforced, so the model states whether it enforces the contract it ships with rather than leaving a reader to grep for it

THREE_REAL_DEFECTS_FOUND_WHILE_DOING_THI.defect: 'how many unique words in data.txt' returned pass=True, answer=None
THREE_REAL_DEFECTS_FOUND_WHILE_DOING_THI.how_it_happened: there was no refinement edge from `uniquelines` to `words`, so the question resolved to NO kind; with no kind, the door fell past the confined bridge and ran a raw `wc -w`, which printed '6 data.txt' and exited 0
THREE_REAL_DEFECTS_FOUND_WHILE_DOING_THI.why_that_is_the_worst_kind_of_wrong: it is a correct execution of the wrong command, reported as success. A caller checking `pass` gets a green light and a number that answers a different question
THREE_REAL_DEFECTS_FOUND_WHILE_DOING_THI.fix_1: `unique words` is declared as a refinement of `words`, so it RESOLVES and is then refused by name -- a refusal a caller can read beats a fast wrong answer
THREE_REAL_DEFECTS_FOUND_WHILE_DOING_THI.fix_2: a counting question that produced no number now returns FAIL_CLOSED__EXECUTION_PRODUCED_NO_ANSWER with the confinement evidence attached
THREE_REAL_DEFECTS_FOUND_WHILE_DOING_THI.fix_2_scope: narrowed twice before it was right: keying on the bridge layer missed the case (the bridge refuses it first, and the raw carrier answers), while applying it to stated commands broke `sort -u data.txt`, whose listing IS its answer. The rule now keys on WHAT WAS ASKED.

THREE_REAL_DEFECTS_FOUND_WHILE_DOING_THI.detail: the first version of the rule referenced `goal`, which is not a parameter of `_answer`; the NameError was swallowed by the except clause and the rule silently never fired. A fail-open inside the code written to prevent a fail-open.
THREE_REAL_DEFECTS_FOUND_WHILE_DOING_THI.fix: the question is passed explicitly by the caller, and the module default is fail-CLOSED

THREE_REAL_DEFECTS_FOUND_WHILE_DOING_THI.defect: the door returned '6' (string) on one path and 6 (int) on another
THREE_REAL_DEFECTS_FOUND_WHILE_DOING_THI.detail: the bridge returns `answer` as a display string and `value` as the typed number. A caller comparing == 6 passed on one layer and failed on the other.
THREE_REAL_DEFECTS_FOUND_WHILE_DOING_THI.fix: the door surfaces the typed value first and coerces a digit string; the bridge keeps its split, because display and type are genuinely different jobs

what_is_not_done_and_must_not_be_claimed: the gate engine enforces submission discipline; it does NOT make the model smarter. Nothing here improves the 22.2% SWE rate.
the 10 gates are the contract's own gates, not a validated predictor of patch quality. No experiment yet shows that passing all 10 correlates with a green suite.

failure_triage_v1 routes on status STRINGS, which is a heuristic. It is a table, not a proof, and an unrecognised status stops rather than guesses -- which is the best available behaviour, not a guarantee.
the Supreme documents themselves (775 lines) are still prose a reader must apply; only the 10 gates became code.
the_next_harness_step__identified_not_bu: The 2026 literature converges on four harness moves: structure-aware error recovery (done here), context compaction, plan/execute separation, and a search subagent. Of those, SEARCH is the highest measured ROI -- WarpGrep as a search subagent added +2.1 to +3.7 points on SWE-bench Pro across every model tested. This tree has capability_selection_retrieval_v1 and adaptive_retrieval_query_expansion_v1, but no subagent that searches the repository and reports locations rather than content. That is the next build.
